text:
eve: Heads-up: doing a multi-repo docs refactor spanning docs-site and docs-snippets repos. Will create 3 PRs across repos. Need an exact merge plan.
rob: Yikes cross-repo. Do previews exist for both repos? We had parity issues last quarter.
eve: Yes — docs-site on Netlify, docs-snippets on Vercel. I spun up a staging redirect service `staging-redirects.redwood-internal` to avoid public 302s until everything is green.
kevin: Good call. Proposed sequence: (A) open redirects-internal PR in docs-site (adds temporary redirect mapping pointing old -> staging redirects), (B) move files in docs-snippets and update includes, (C) patch docs-site anchors and TOC, (D) swap redirects to public and remove staging redirects after 48h.
tara: Suggest holding public redirects for 48-72h to let search engines and partner caches catch up. Add TTL comment in redirects.yaml.
ops-bot: Preview up: https://staging-docs-preview-404.internal for PR #404 (docs-site) and https://snippets-preview-405.internal for PR #405 (docs-snippets)
eve: I also added `scripts/anchors-checker.sh` that runs across both builds and outputs a CSV of changed anchor ids. Command: `./scripts/anchors-checker.sh --base=main --compare=feature/docs-split > changed-anchors.csv`.
rob: We must be extra careful about anchor-only changes. Some consumers link directly to anchors in emails/SDKs. Gate merges on manual approval from @kevin for anchor churn.
kevin: I'll review anchor CSV and produce a mapping file `anchor-mapping.json` to commit in PR C. Also please add a migration note in docs: "If you link to anchors, update links using anchor-mapping.json."
eve: Added checklist for each PR description: - Preview URL - Build hash - Anchor diff file - Redirect mapping (if applicable) - Reviewer sign-off - CI green - Smoke curl test
rob: Example smoke test: `curl -sI https://docs.redwood.com/guides/sdk/init | sed -n '1,5p'` expect 302 to staging redirect first, then after public flip expect 200 on new path.
docs-bot: CI status: PR #405 docs-snippets: lint OK, build OK. PR #404 docs-site: lint OK, build failed (TOC plugin error at /guides/overview).
eve: Fixing TOC plugin mismatch (plugin config differs between Netlify env and local). Pushing config patch to PR #404 now.
kevin: Also note: Vercel auto-encodes heading ids differently for non-ASCII chars. We had a Japanese heading break last time. Add a normalization step in `anchors-checker.sh`.
tara: Ops: once public redirects go live, someone should run a quick crawl using `linkinator` against top-level sitemap and dump 404s. I can do that during the 11:00-12:30 PST window.
rob: Timing: plan merges Tuesday 11:00 PST. Merge PR #404 (internal redirects) first, wait 10 minutes, then PR #405 (snippets move), then PR #406 (anchor fixes) last, then flip public redirects. Keep rollback plan ready.
eve: I'll assign reviewers: @rob for API/snippet correctness, @kevin for anchor mapping, @tara for smoke infra checks.
ops-bot: Reminder: make sure the redirects TTL comment includes an ISO date for removal.
docs-bot: After PR #405 merge, preview hash -> https://snippets-deploy-405--docs.redwood.com became available.
eve: I'll post post-merge checklist: 1) curl smoke on top 10 changed paths 2) run linkinator and collect 404s 3) verify examples in SDK quickstarts 4) add changelog entry under docs/migration-notes
rob: Also mention partners and platform teams in the CHANGELOG and ping support. We had an outage when a partner used an old anchor in an integration.
kevin: If we see anchor regressions after merge, revert PR #406 (anchor fix) and restore anchor-mapping JSON for consumers.
eve: OK opening PRs now. Will paste links once created. Merge window set for Tue 11:00 PST. Ping me in this thread for any rollback steps.
rob: Thanks — will stand by for previews and run linkinator after each merge.
tara: I'll coordinate CDN warm-up and smoke curl tests.
docs-bot: Note: please include the `staging-redirects` domain in PR descriptions so tests hit the right host.
